title: Granting a Point, Then Answering It
goal: Grant a point formally, then limit it, and add a point worth noting.
grammar: Granting a Point, Then Answering It

items: I can grant a point with *si bien es cierto que* and then limit it.
I can add a point worth noting with *cabe señalar que*.
I can put grant, limit and conclusion in order.
